content: Night passed in sleeping, day passed in eating; this priceless diamond of human birth was traded for a handful of cowrie shells.
author: Kabir
explanation: Human incarnation is a rare, magnificent opportunity for self-realization. Wasting it entirely in unconscious biological maintenance and petty distractions is cosmic tragedy.
practicalInsight: Set aside two intentional hours today for deep creative labor, contemplation, or selfless service.
reflectionPrompt: Am I trading the diamond of my limited human days for the cheap cowries of mindless entertainment?
